# New to MESA

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_pathways.py from data/pathways.yml. Do not edit this file: change the data and run the script. -->

Sign in, start a notebook, and keep what you make.

**The essentials: 3 tutorials, 15 to 25 minutes in all.** Take them in order, or start wherever your question is. Nothing is locked. Each point also lists what to take if you have more time.

!!! warning "These tutorials are drafts"
    Each tutorial says at the top how far it has been checked.

## Orient and navigate

*Work in MESA.* You can get into MESA, find data, run an app, and keep what you make.

1. [Sign in to the MESA Portal with a CyVerse account](../tutorials/sign-in.md) (5 minutes)
2. [Launch MESA JupyterLab with your Data Store mounted](../tutorials/launch-jupyterlab.md) (5 to 10 minutes)
3. [Save your work where it survives the session](../tutorials/save-your-work.md) (5 to 10 minutes)

If you have more time:

- [Find your way around the MESA Portal](../tutorials/find-your-way-around.md) (5 minutes)
- [Find MESA's community data in the Data Browser](../tutorials/find-community-data.md) (5 minutes)
- [Stop an app and find your results](../tutorials/stop-app-find-results.md) (5 minutes)
